description: Ed25519 public keys whose signatures the ARI leaderboard accepts. A signature only says who signed if the key is checked against a list decided in advance, so this file is that list. leaderboard/scoring/score.py marks a row `attested` only when its attestation verifies against a key named here; every other row is `self-reported`.
how_to_add: Publish the public key somewhere a reader can check it independently (org site, keybase, DNS TXT), then add it here in the same pull request as the first report it signs. Never add a key generated for one run: a verifier checks the key against a registry it already trusts, so a key that appears with its own first signature proves nothing.

signers.holder: The SEMQ Group — ARI leaderboard operator
signers.custody: AWS KMS ECC_NIST_EDWARDS25519; the private key never leaves the HSM and every signature lands in CloudTrail. Provisioned as code in semq-infra (kms/create-signing-key.sh).
